en: Steven
{player}! Good timing. There's something on this bridge that nobody can see. Will you help me find out what?
Are your Pokémon ready now? Let's see what's hiding on this bridge.
No hurry. I'll wait here until you're ready.
Then show me what you and your Pokémon can do!
This is the Devon Scope. With it, a Pokémon that blends into its surroundings can't hide.
Steven
So it was a Kecleon. It changes its colours to match whatever is round it. Clever, isn't it?
You saw what the Scope can do. Take it. There are more of them about, and you'll find them now.
I'm going on ahead. Something is stirring in Hoenn, {player}, and I want to see it with my own eyes.
We'll meet again. Take care of yourself.
Something unseeable is in the way.
Beauty
Don't you think berries are a kind of love letter? From the soil, to whoever picks them?
I knew you'd understand! Then you should have one of mine.
Oh, you'll see it one day. Here, maybe this will help you understand.
That one's hard to come by. Plant it and raise it with care!
I'm off to the Berry Master's later for more. Come back tomorrow and I'll have another for you.
Robert
Your Pokémon fly true! Let's exchange numbers and train together sometime.
Register Robert in the PokéNav's Match Call?
Great! I'll call when Swablu learns something new.
Ah well. The sky's big enough for both of us.
Jeffrey
You know your stuff! Want my number? I'll tell you about every bug I find.
Register Jeffrey in the PokéNav's Match Call?
Brilliant! Expect lots of calls about Surskit.
Fine, fine. More bugs for me!
